package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for leading_wildcard_builder_chain: LIKE queries with leading wildcards that prevent index usage.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: data_access; severity: contextual.

type Article struct {
	ID    int
	Title string
	Body  string
}

func SearchArticles(db *gorm.DB, keyword string) ([]Article, error) {
	var articles []Article
	err := db.Where("title LIKE ?", "%"+keyword+"%").
		Order("id desc").
		Find(&articles).Error
	return articles, err
}

func FindByDescription(db *gorm.DB, term string) ([]Article, error) {
	var results []Article
	err := db.Where("body LIKE ?", "%"+term+"%").
		Limit(20).Find(&results).Error
	return results, err
}
